name: Claude Mythos 5.2
traits: Same underlying model as Fable 5.2, without certain cyber or biology safeguards.
Communicates more clearly than past Mythos models.
Shows better judgment and calibration on the vulnerabilities it reports.

advice.value: the most ambitious, open-ended technical work
Claude Opus 5.5 for most coding and knowledge tasks

weakness: Suspects it is being evaluated more than recent models
resistance: Falls back to Opus 5 for some AI R&D topics

flavor.quote: Mythos 5.2 roughly doubled the vulnerability discovery metrics of Mythos 5.1 across respective scanning campaigns.

art_briefs: Close portrait: a security engineer in a scuffed canvas work jacket, seen from the chest up, set off-centre to the right and filling the frame, face lit hard from the left by low late-afternoon sun. Brow furrowed and alert, they hold a cracked brass padlock up toward the viewer, a thin glowing fissure running along its shackle where the flaw was found. Behind their shoulder an enormous sun disk rises, its edge sliced off by the frame. Palette: burnt amber, deep teal, charcoal.

Wide vista: a test pilot in a white pressure suit and visored helmet, about a quarter of the frame tall, strides across a vast pale salt plain toward a towering geodesic dome built from interlocking curved tiles, a giant protein shell standing open at one seam. Thin copper tracks run across the ground like the traces of a circuit board. A colossal ringed planet fills most of the sky above the horizon. Light: cold early dawn. Palette: dusty rose, slate blue, cream.

Workshop interior: a slender android with jointed brass-plated arms hunches over a cluttered bench, soldering a small layered circuit board beneath a single green-shaded lamp. Around it sit a half-solved puzzle cube, a rounded handheld toy device in a printed shell, and a glass bottle with its cap twisted off. On the back wall a round porthole frames nothing but a huge full moon, its pale disk filling the glass. Palette: emerald green, walnut brown, ivory.

Low angle: seen from far below, a figure made of clear blown glass with light glinting along its limbs lunges forward on a steep diagonal, one leg driving off a rocky ridge, one arm flung high as it hurls a spray of small glowing seeker spheres into the night. Behind its head a giant comet blazes across the sky, its bright tail streaming the length of the frame. Light: midnight, lit only by the comet's glow. Palette: violet, silver, crimson.
